title: Project Background
shortDescription: Context, problem space, selection matrix, SID framework, and team.
description: Comprehensive overview of our research inquiry: investigating the invisibility of ecological impacts in ubiquitous mobility, our multi-parameter selection matrix, the Sustainable Interaction Design (SID) framework, and our research cohort.

title: Week 01 — Contextual Inquiry & Discovery
shortDescription: Field observations, commuter interviews, and transit friction mapping.
description: Field inquiry conducted across key Lisbon transit hubs. We shadowed student commuters to trace everyday friction points between Metro de Lisboa lines and shared micromobility services.

title: Week 02 — Conceptual Prototyping & Low-Fi Probes
shortDescription: Translating insights into tangible ambient indicators and physical mockups.
description: Translating discovery findings into physical interaction concepts and low-power tangible indicators.
